# Stable Diffusion Unity Integration

> Unity Editor components that call an AUTOMATIC1111 WebUI HTTP API and apply the returned image to a UI graphic or a mesh material. The tool does not include a diffusion runtime or checkpoints.

This file only points at the support manual. It is not a second copy of that manual, and assistants are not guaranteed to load it.
